Class EfsRow<E extends IEfsEvent>

java.lang.Object
org.efs.io.EfsRow<E>
Type Parameters:
E - efs event type.
All Implemented Interfaces:
IEfsEvent
@Immutable public final class EfsRow<E extends IEfsEvent> extends Object implements IEfsEvent
Contains event publish timestamp and row index for a given event.

    • createRow

      public static <E extends IEfsEvent> EfsRow<E> createRow(@Nonnull Instant timestamp, long rowIndex, @Nonnull E event)
      Returns a new efs event row generated from the given arguments. The event tags are an empty set.
      Type Parameters:
      E - efs event type.
      Parameters:
      timestamp - event timestamp.
      rowIndex - event row index.
      event - efs event contained in row.
      Returns:
      efs event row.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if either timestamp or event is null.
      IllegalArgumentException - if rowIndex < zero.

    • createRow

      public static <E extends IEfsEvent> EfsRow<E> createRow(@Nonnull Instant timestamp, long rowIndex, @Nonnull Set<Integer> tags, @Nonnull E event)
      Returns a new efs event row generated from the given arguments.
      Type Parameters:
      E - efs event type.
      Parameters:
      timestamp - event timestamp.
      rowIndex - event row index.
      tags - optional event tags. May be empty but not null.
      event - efs event contained in row.
      Returns:
      efs event row.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if either timestamp, tags, or event is null.
      IllegalArgumentException - if rowIndex < zero.
